summary: Yonkers Public Schools urges the FCC to keep E‑Rate funding robust, preserve the current discount matrix, maintain Category One and Two support, and keep screen‑time policy local. Yonkers Public Schools oppose conditioning E‑Rate on screen‑time limits, reject sunset or narrowing of the program, and call for clear, privacy‑protective CIPA obligations while preserving needs‑based support for high‑poverty districts.
